# Route Rules Requirements Quality Checklist: Routes and Dispatch

**Purpose**: Formal gate on the quality of the requirements for route building and ordering, lifecycle and cross-feature consistency, reassignment and custody, and integrity, before they are turned into tasks
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · supporting: [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/http-api.md](../contracts/http-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: route building and ordering · lifecycle and consistency with features 001 and 003 · reassignment, custody, and handovers · integrity
**Depth**: formal gate · **Reviewer and timing**: project owner, before `/speckit-tasks`

## Route Building and Ordering — Completeness and Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is the initial order of stops of a newly created route specified as a requirement, and not only shown in an acceptance scenario? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §US1]
- [x] CHK002 Is "distinct pickup address" defined precisely enough to decide when two shipments share a pickup stop (same pickup point, or same one-off address)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Is the position of a new pickup stop specified when a shipment is added to a route that has no pending pickup stop for its address? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK004 Is it unambiguous whether "Sin asignar" is grouped by pickup point and rate zone at the same time, or by one with the other as a filter? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK005 Is the unit counted by the 15-delivery confirmation threshold defined (shipments, delivery stops, or stops)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §EC-09]
- [x] CHK006 Is it stated whether several deliveries to the same place (for example, one bus terminal) share a delivery stop or stay one stop per shipment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are the route statuses in which stops may be reordered stated explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Are ordering constraints defined for errand stops and for reverse pickups, or is their absence stated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified for which service dates a route may be created (past, today, future)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK010 Is the service-date rule for adding shipments to a route expressed clearly enough to be tested with concrete dates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Is the total "COD amount to collect" of a route defined (which shipments it includes and whether it changes with progress)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK012 Are empty states required for "no unassigned shipments", "no routes for this date", and "no active couriers"? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-018]

## Lifecycle and Cross-Feature Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Does the "Finalizada" rule in the spec account for handovers still pending, consistently with the data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Data model §Route lifecycle]
- [x] CHK014 Is it stated whether a finished route can ever reopen, for example when a shipment in "Novedad" is sent back for a new attempt? [Gap, Spec §EC-07, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK015 Are the shipment transitions implemented here consistent with the lifecycle table of feature 001, including the three transitions added during clarification? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Feature 001 data model]
- [x] CHK016 Is undoing a dispatch defined for a route that holds a shipment already picked up (received through reassignment) even though none of its own stops is completed? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK017 Is reassigning a picked-up shipment into a route in preparation, which may have no courier, either defined or excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK018 Do FR-008 (change the courier of a route in preparation) and FR-015 (reassign a whole route in preparation with a reason) define one consistent rule? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK019 Is it specified what the dispatcher may do with a shipment in "Novedad" that is still on a route, or is that explicitly deferred to feature 003? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK020 Is the handling of a return to sender (physical trip back to the merchant) on a route either specified or explicitly deferred to feature 003? [Dependency, Gap]
- [x] CHK021 Is it stated what happens when a courier's action, recorded offline, arrives for a shipment the dispatcher has already removed or reassigned? [Gap, Dependency, Constitution II]
- [x] CHK022 Are the dependencies on feature 003 (completing stops, confirming handovers, telling the courier that a dispatched route changed) listed as assumptions? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Reassignment, Custody, and Handovers

- [x] CHK023 Is the status of a shipment after reassignment specified for every starting status ("Asignado", "En ruta", "Recogido") and target route status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK024 Is it clear whether moving a shipment between two routes of the same courier is a reassignment that needs a reason? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK025 Is it defined what happens to a pending handover when the shipment is reassigned again before it is confirmed? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK026 Is it specified who may confirm and who may cancel a handover, for each role? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK027 Are the moments at which custody changes stated exhaustively and consistently between the requirements and the key entities? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK028 Is "completed stops keep the courier who did them" reconciled with shipments that courier had picked up and not delivered when a whole route is reassigned? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §US4]
- [x] CHK029 Can SC-005 ("which courier had it, and when, with no gaps") be verified objectively from the recorded events? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK030 Is the content of a reassignment reason constrained consistently across reassign, undo dispatch, and cancel? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-017, §FR-026]

## Integrity and Access

- [x] CHK031 Is "exactly one effect when repeated" specified for every route action and not only for creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK032 Is the expected outcome of a concurrent change described from the user's point of view (what they see and what they keep)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §EC-02]
- [x] CHK033 Are the limits "one route in progress per courier" and "one active route per shipment" stated as requirements that hold under simultaneous actions by two dispatchers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK034 Is it stated who can see a route's history and the custody history? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK035 Are the actions listed in FR-022 the complete set of route actions defined elsewhere in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]

## Acceptance Criteria and Traceability

- [x] CHK036 Does every edge case map to a functional requirement that fully states its rule? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK037 Are acceptance scenarios defined for the keyboard path of reordering and for the large-route confirmation? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK038 Is SC-002 ("none is unaccounted for") expressed so that it can be checked for any moment of the day? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline

## Review record

- **2026-09-30**: all 38 items evaluated by the assistant at the reviewer's explicit request
  and marked satisfied after revising the spec. Only CHK022 was satisfied as written; the
  other 37 required a change, from a one-phrase precision to a new rule.
- The spec went from 26 to 27 functional requirements (FR-027 empty states) and from 13 to
  16 edge cases; FR-001–FR-006, FR-008, FR-009, FR-011, FR-012, FR-014–FR-016, FR-018–FR-022,
  FR-025, and FR-026 were tightened.
- Rules decided by the assistant, open to the reviewer's change:
  - a picked-up shipment can move only to a route in progress (CHK017);
  - a whole-route reassignment applies to routes in progress; in preparation the courier is
    just changed, without a reason (CHK018);
  - undoing a dispatch is refused if the route holds any picked-up shipment (CHK016);
  - moving a picked-up shipment between two routes of the same courier needs no handover
    (CHK024);
  - routes are created for today or a future date, never a past one (CHK009);
  - finished and cancelled routes never reopen (CHK014).
- Deferred to feature 003 and recorded under Assumptions: decisions on "Novedad", the return
  trip to the merchant, and how a courier's offline action is applied after the dispatcher
  changed the route (CHK019–CHK021).
- Feature 001's lifecycle table was aligned with this feature's transitions (CHK015).
